共同操作

A1

步骤 1：add p-toluenesulfonyl isocyanate dropwise to allenylic alcohol in dry dichloromethane；步骤 2：stir at 0 °C；步骤 3：remove ice bath, warm to room temperature and stir；步骤 4：concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 5：purify by flash chromatography (5-20% EtOAc/hexanes)

A2

步骤 1：add sulfonyl isocyanate to allenylic alcohol and stir；步骤 2：allow solution to warm/stir at room temperature

A3

步骤 1：add allenylic carbamate solution to phosphine solution；步骤 2：stir after addition

A4

步骤 1：deaerate solvent by bubbling with argon；步骤 2：add carbamate solution to phosphine solution at room temperature；步骤 3：stir after addition at room temperature

A5

步骤 1：add solution of 9 by syringe pump to solution/suspension of pronucleophile and listed reagents；步骤 2：stir after addition

A6

步骤 1：add SnCl2 and NaI sequentially in one portion to propargyl bromide solution in DMPU；步骤 2：stir protected from light；步骤 3：cool reaction mixture；步骤 4：add aldehyde solution over 15 min；步骤 5：stir after aldehyde addition；步骤 6：warm to room temperature and stir protected from light；步骤 7：cool to 0 °C, dilute with ether, quench with saturated NH4Cl, extract, wash with brine, dry, filter and concentrate；步骤 8：purify by flash chromatography (5-10% EtOAc/hexanes)

实验记录

1 · Page 10, Experimental Section, preparation of 7a; summary also on page 3
+→

投料：paraformaldehyde 2.82 g，89.2 mmol；3-hydroxyquinuclidine 472 mg，3.57 mmol；ethyl 2,3-butadienoate 2.01 g，17.9 mmol；THF 100 mL；NH4Cl 50 mL；EtOAc 150 mL；NaCl 50 mL；Na2SO4 用量未提供

条件：55 °C，1 h；-15 °C，5 min；-15 °C，1 h；room temperature，3.75 h

步骤 1：hold paraformaldehyde under vacuum to remove water；步骤 2：cool paraformaldehyde suspension in THF；步骤 3：add 3-hydroxyquinuclidine solution dropwise；步骤 4：add ethyl 2,3-butadienoate solution dropwise；步骤 5：stir at -15 °C；步骤 6：remove cooling bath, warm to room temperature and stir；步骤 7：quench with saturated NH4Cl; extract with EtOAc; wash with brine; dry, filter and concentrate；步骤 8：purify by flash chromatography (15% EtOAc/hexanes)

结果：收率 66%（分离）；product_amount 7a：1.67 g

结果说明：reaction outcome

构型：paraformaldehyde：原子手性 no source-specified stereochemistry for the named reagent；双键构型 not applicable or not source-specified；ethyl 2,3-butadienoate：原子手性 no source-specified stereochemistry for the named reagent；双键构型 not applicable or not source-specified；7a：原子手性 no stereogenic center shown；双键构型 allene geometry shown without an E/Z descriptor；轴手性 terminal allene carbon is CH2; allene is not axially stereogenic as drawn

来源：Page 10, Experimental Section, preparation of 7a; summary also on page 3；证据页：正文 PDF 第 3,10 页

2 · Page 11, Experimental Section, preparation of 7b; summary also on page 3
+→

投料：3-hydroxyquinuclidine 460 mg，3.55 mmol；ethyl 2,3-butadienoate 2.03 g，18.1 mmol；acetaldehyde 35.8 mmol，2 mL；Et2O 10 mL；NH4Cl 10 mL；EtOAc 30 mL；H2O 10 mL；NaCl 10 mL；Na2SO4 用量未提供

条件：-15 °C，5 min；-15 °C，1 min，氩气；-15 °C，50 min

步骤 1：add ethyl 2,3-butadienoate dropwise to 3-hydroxyquinuclidine in dry ether；步骤 2：add pre-cooled acetaldehyde dropwise；步骤 3：stir at -15 °C；步骤 4：quench with saturated NH4Cl; extract with EtOAc; wash with water and brine; dry, filter and concentrate；步骤 5：purify by flash chromatography (10% EtOAc/hexanes)

结果：收率 79%（分离）；product_amount 7b：2.2 g

结果说明：reaction outcome

构型：ethyl 2,3-butadienoate：原子手性 no source-specified stereochemistry for the named reagent；双键构型 not applicable or not source-specified；acetaldehyde：原子手性 no source-specified stereochemistry for the named reagent；双键构型 not applicable or not source-specified；7b：原子手性 stereogenic center present; configuration unspecified；双键构型 allene geometry shown without an E/Z descriptor；轴手性 terminal allene carbon is CH2; allene is not axially stereogenic as drawn
